name: Sanguine Essence keeps Bloodmoon Blast usable (#5813, #5737)
contract: Sanguine Essence 680692 (Rank 'Cursed Form') reads: 'Enter a unique Cursed Form that does not disable
Mortal Form abilties ... While active, you replicate $s1% of healing or damage done by Sanguine Mend and
Bloodmoon Blast'. Every Bloodmoon Blast rank (500125, 501607-501614, 572332) carries
ExcludeCasterAuraSpell 524861, the Mortal Form lockout marker that ordinary Cursed Forms set and that
Spell.cpp:5865 turns into SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE (22). Sanguine Essence replaces Blood Curse for
the Fleshweaver spec, so it keeps both Cursed Form markers 525031 and 524861; 53 Cursed ability records
(Rotclaw 12 ranks among them) require 524861. Under Sanguine Essence Bloodmoon Blast rank 10 must cast
without a failure and damage its target, and Rotclaw 503486 must still ravage a nearby enemy. Rotclaw uses
original MELEE hit resolution; the fixture supplies native melee hit and expertise as well as the spell
